text: Guided systematic review workflow covering search, screening, extraction and report generation
quote: The Systematic Reviews workflow provides step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers.

text: Users can set an effort/depth level (e.g. Fastest to Smartest) for each Research Agent session
quote: Every Research Agent session runs at an effort level, which you set from the slider in the prompt box before you send your question.

text: Instant email alerts notify users when new relevant papers matching a saved search appear
quote: Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.

text: Users can import existing paper collections from Zotero into Elicit
quote: Import from Zotero

text: Library can be exported as .ris for import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote or other reference managers
quote: Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.

text: Elicit provides an API to programmatically search papers and generate research reports
quote: The Elicit API lets you access Elicit's research capabilities programmatically: search 138 million+ academic papers and generate automated research reports from your own code, scripts, and workflows.

text: Projects let users link multiple sessions together for continuous reasoning across a body of work
quote: Projects in Elicit allow you to link together multiple sessions for fluid reasoning across different aspects of your work.

text: Skills are reusable instruction sets that make the agent approach recurring tasks a set way, invoked via slash command
quote: A skill is a set of instructions you can hand to Elicit's agent so it approaches a task a particular way.

text: Team members can be invited into live Research Agent sessions with edit access to ask questions and produce/edit artifacts
quote: Collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions in your session, produce new artifacts (documents, tables, etc.), and edit other artifacts

text: Browser extension uses the user's institutional logins to fetch full-text papers otherwise inaccessible
quote: The extension uses your active logins in your browser to download papers you can access via your institution.

text: Users can add extraction table columns just by telling the agent in natural language what to extract
quote: To add a column, simply tell the research agent what column(s) you'd like to add. For example, you can say: "Add a column for study type."

text: Research Agent pulls from a wide range of source types (publications, filings, press releases), produces flexible outputs, and lets users iterate
quote: the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need

text: Elicit automatically fetches full-text papers during the data extraction phase of a systematic review
quote: Elicit will automatically fetch papers during the data extraction phase of your Systematic Reviews

text: Users define custom extraction columns that pull data from paper body text or embedded tables
quote: Create a column for each data point you'd like to extract from your papers. Columns can pull data from the papers' body text or from tables in the papers.

text: Screening recommendation and data extraction tables can be exported (Pro/Scale/Enterprise) in CSV/Excel/RIS/BIB/PDF/DOCX
quote: Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.

text: Semantic search lets users find relevant papers using natural-language questions instead of exact keywords
quote: With Elicit's semantic search engine, you can ask a question in natural language, and Elicit will find relevant papers, without you having to think of every possible keyword to search for.

text: Within a chat session users can filter/export sources, generate figures, and draft slides without leaving the conversation
quote: you can filter and export your sources, generate figures, and draft slides, all without leaving the conversation

text: Elicit's MCP server can be added to MCP-compatible clients like Claude Desktop/Code via a simple CLI command
quote: claude mcp add --transport http elicit https://elicit.com/api/mcp

text: Users can import RIS/BIB files from other reference tools (EndNote, Mendeley, Rayyan) for automated screening/extraction
quote: You can import RIS and BIB files into Elicit. This makes it much easier to import titles/abstracts from other tools like EndNote, Mendeley, or Rayyan to use with Elicit's automated screening and extraction.

text: Chat can compare/contrast, summarize along dimensions, and cluster multiple papers by topic
quote: Chat enables you to: Compare and contrast papers - Summarize multiple papers along specific dimensions (like their methodologies) - Cluster papers by a certain topic

text: Search covers both academic research papers and clinical trials
quote: Elicit allows you to search both research papers and clinical trials.

text: Full-Text Screening is a distinct automated workflow step that catches abstract/full-text mismatches before extraction
quote: Full-Text Screening is a distinct, automated step in the Systematic Review workflow that catches these mismatches before you commit to data extraction.

text: Advanced search filters let users restrict results to a specific journal or highly-cited papers
quote: Advanced search filters are a powerful hidden feature in the Find Papers workflow. You can use them to search within a particular journal, restrict your search to highly-cited papers, and more!

text: Collections let users organize imported papers and quickly launch reviews or extractions from them
quote: You can now organize and manage your papers in the Elicit Library using Collections. Collections help you group related research, arrange it the way you want, and quickly launch reviews or extractions.

text: Full Elicit API functionality is also exposed via an MCP server for MCP-compatible clients
quote: All API functionality is also available via MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, enabling use from Claude Desktop, Claude Code, and other MCP-compatible clients.
